first_causal_failure.description: The frame lifted initially but slipped during wrist rotation. Armed empty-sized flags first appeared at steps 271 and 295; the timed condition completed the rotation/transfer until step 380.

recovery.description: Astra cited empty fingers and the frame away from the hand; selected a deeper regrasp in decision 7 and split the rotation across decisions 8/9.
Insertion ended 40.28 mm above target with load/stall flags; Astra cited a firm stop/increased load before release in decision 13.
Tool approach ended 88.72 mm from target after load; decision 19 selected lift/turn, but its wrist rotation ended 1.342 rad short.
Astra explicitly noticed incomplete orientation and requested settling; position still ended 46.27 mm from target.
Astra described the hook visible through the larger opening. Final translations reached within 1.5 mm of EEF targets, but the eventual required tool/hook relation was incorrect.
Declared full completion after release, with five decisions and 340 control steps unused. Frame native check passes; tool check never passed.

native_terminal_checks: Frame passes. Larger-hole center is 43.748 mm from hook line (limit 6.75 mm), no horizontal-hook contact, and failed straddling despite insertion fraction 0.7208. Neither hole passes.
terminal_contact_context: Tool larger ring contacts frame_grip_frame; smaller ring contacts table_collision. No terminal robot/tool contact appears in rebuilt geometry. Contact geometry does not reconstruct forces or prove load support.
mechanism_interpretation: Timed execution continued after a declared empty-sized warning, but Astra recovered the slip. Final failure is an object-relation/completion-judgment error, not an empty grasp. The matched guarded episode succeeds after two interrupts and a different recovery placement, which does not identify those stops as the sole cause of final success.
replay: All 2060 recovered trajectory states, 38 camera snapshots, 2040 monitor/action rows and 2060 native checks reproduce exactly. Reconstructed 580-step prefix matched retained original robot/object/scoring records and final RGB-D; original full hidden prefix arrays were not retained.
infrastructure: Same-context recovery after intentional root interruption. Already-completed decision 8 relayed unchanged without another inference; one dispatch/delivery interval missing, recovered host origin approximate.
reason_scope: Short returned command reasons audited against public measurements and executed motion; private geometry only diagnoses discrepancy. No private internal reasoning exported.
